baseline_gap_evidence.gap_text: Onboarding proves weak-business low-confidence + missing-data; a dedicated end-to-end assertion that a confident diagnosis is BLOCKED (not merely low) on contradictory/insufficient evidence is owed (ties to the Wave-7 isDataSufficient fail-closed unit proof).
baseline_gap_evidence.wave7_prior_proof: src/services/control/__tests__/recommendation.test.ts proves isDataSufficient primitive in isolation only

proof_tests.lane: required maintained vitest suite (CI - Build & Test)
assertions: insufficient patterns (<3) => blocked=true, INSUFFICIENT_PATTERNS, confidenceScore=0, dataSufficiency=insufficient, no recommendedAction (high var confidence)
low-confidence/contradictory evidence (var confidence <0.6) => blocked=true, LOW_CONFIDENCE_VARIABLES, confidenceScore=0
sufficient patterns but unmet >60% success => dataSufficiency=insufficient but NOT blocked (distinct 'merely low' state), contrasted with a confidence-0 hard block
sufficient + strong + trustworthy => blocked falsy, dataSufficiency=sufficient, confidenceScore>0.6, concrete recommendedAction (gate not always-block)
generateMultipleRecommendations blocks the whole set on INSUFFICIENT_PATTERNS
generateMultipleRecommendations blocks the whole set on LOW_CONFIDENCE_VARIABLES

validation_commands: static trace of every assertion against src/services/intelligence/recommendation.ts + src/services/control/recommendation.ts + src/services/control/variable-registry.ts
npx vitest run src/services/intelligence/__tests__/recommendation-fail-closed.test.ts (delegated to PR CI; node_modules absent locally as in prior Phase-1 waves)
